newsitem.title: USA: Most U.S. debt futures turn slightly lower late.
newsitem.headline: Most U.S. debt futures turn slightly lower late.

text.p: June 10 - Most U.S. debt futures turned down slightly late, but traders called action light and noncommittal. One notes trader cited corporate supply woes, Sept T-bond's inability to pierce 111-00 earlier. Sept bond slipped through Monday's 110-17/32 low. Fed's Greenspan speaks at 2000 CDT/0100 GMT.
